_ceiling_composition: setup and every core step at its bound ($1.4, 76.4 min at $1.09/h incl. disk), rounded up to the cent, + the $0.3 teardown reserve
rate_rule: re-quoted live at launch; the launcher derives the session ceiling and timeout from the live rate and refuses if the cap no longer buys the work
covers: stage V of topk_adoption_driver.py on one L40S pod: the steps of plan.json, nothing else
does_not_cover: a D2 search, recovery training or a behavioural probe
a second pod for a failed step without a recorded engineering cause
any spend above the all-in ceiling, cumulative across subruns
_executable_commit_is: the commit the pod checks out; every executed path and record is identical between it and the commit carrying this proposal (tested)
activation: the maintainer's grant is recorded by writing this record as authorization.json with status GRANTED, granted_utc, granted_by and the live pre-launch checks; until then engineering_campaign_budget.py cannot read a ceiling and the launcher creates nothing. The run id replaces d2val_<utc>
on_ordinary_failure: repair and retry inside this ceiling (AGENTS.md P12.1); a deterministic paid failure is never retried unchanged
authorizes: stage V engineering sessions inside the all-in ceiling, cumulative across every subrun; nothing else -- not a D2 search, recovery, screening, confirmation, D3 or a cap change
granted_by: maintainer, via the Stage V conditional engineering authorization (2026-10-14): $1.70 cumulative all-in, $1.40 session cap, $0.77 expected, one L40S, stage V only
decision_record: logs/budget/decisions.md 2026-10-14 (Stage V conditional engineering authorization ($1.70) and its pre-launch fixes)
conditions_met: evidence adopted against the caller's repository root
executable commit re-bound: d09fc8f7, identical executed paths and records in the tree carrying this record (tested)
one_use: this grant funds stage V sessions inside the $1.70 cumulative ceiling; a retry needs a recorded engineering cause and never resets the ledger or raises the session cap
